uniq-wardstone-shard-focus.flavor: Knocked loose from the third plateau monolith when the climate wards fractured under alkali storm-pressure. It tingles faintly against the palm and smells of sharp ozone whenever clouds gather over Redmarsh.

uniq-bram-axle-shield.summary: Act II unique Warrior iron shield from questing, delivering solid armor, high health, and lightning resistance.
uniq-bram-axle-shield.flavor: When Wagon Four snapped its axle in the Ochre Ditch, Quartermaster Bram ordered the iron-rimmed wheel bolted to a spare saddle-strap so the teamsters had cover. It is absurdly heavy, smells of wagon grease, and stops hornbow shafts cold.

uniq-vorn-retreat-boots.summary: Act II unique all-class tracker treads dropped by Dune Lurkers, granting high speed, armor, and accuracy.
uniq-vorn-retreat-boots.flavor: Fitted with blunt bronze spurs that point slightly inward so a scout can kick free of soft alkali crust without losing his boots. Their original owner insisted he never fled a battle—he merely repositioned aggressively toward the rear.

uniq-embalmer-linen-robe.summary: Act II unique Mage weaver robe dropped by Crypt Embalmers, adding Mind, maximum mana, and high poison resistance.
uniq-embalmer-linen-robe.flavor: Cut from Third-Dynasty burial linen steeped in dark bitumen and bitter myrrh until the weave turned stiff as oilcloth. It rustles like dry parchment when you walk, yet marsh venom and crypt-spores slide right off the hem.

uniq-mirage-hunters-bow.summary: Act II unique Archer recurve bow dropped by Dune Beasts, combining high accuracy, critical chance, and fire resistance.
uniq-mirage-hunters-bow.flavor: Seasoned over Redmarsh salt-pans until the horn belly warped into a wicked, shimmering curve. Marksmen claim aiming down its stave cuts right through noon heat-haze, letting an arrow find a crouching raider before he blinks.

uniq-gorrathul-gizzard-stone.summary: Act II unique all-class stone charm from the Sand Glutton, granting high health, armor, and strong poison resistance.
uniq-gorrathul-gizzard-stone.flavor: A smooth, fist-sized lump of mineral salt and swallowed ironstone pried from the cistern guardian's chest-plate. It stays oddly cold in blistering desert heat and turns aside venoms that would drop a mule in ten paces.

uniq-sera-bone-saw.summary: Act III unique Warrior flamberge from questing, pairing Body and high critical chance with strong lifesteal.
uniq-sera-bone-saw.flavor: Chief Healer Sera never meant for her heavy surgical saw to be swung in anger, yet when raiders rushed the infirmary tents, she worked with what was clean. The wavy teeth tear through mail links with grim, clinical efficiency.

uniq-sunken-castellan-plate.summary: Act III unique all-class hardened brigandine dropped by Salt Crabs, granting high armor, cold resistance, and health.
uniq-sunken-castellan-plate.flavor: Dredged from the flooded courtyard of the Sunken Citadel with a crust of pale sea-barnacles still cemented to the shoulders. Scraping them off ruins the lacquer, and besides, the rough shells catch boarding blades surprisingly well.

uniq-baron-embezzled-signet.summary: Act III unique all-class scribe ring found in chests, boosting Mind, maximum mana, and critical strike chance.
uniq-baron-embezzled-signet.flavor: Baron Vane kept two signets: a dull pewter one for tax collectors, and this gleaming silver band for his private smuggling tallies. The underside is hollowed out slightly, just deep enough to hide a pinch of cipher-dust.

uniq-lyra-last-arbalest.summary: Act III unique Archer heavy arbalest dropped by Hollow Knights, adding high accuracy, critical chance, and Body.
uniq-lyra-last-arbalest.flavor: The iron stirrup is bent from being slammed into a jammed gate-gear during the retreat from Oakhaven's northern watch. Even crooked, its heavy steel prod punches clean through plate at sixty paces without a tremor.

uniq-riverlock-sluice-crank.summary: Act III unique Warrior steel warhammer dropped by Silt Colossi, offering high Body, armor, and lightning resistance.
uniq-riverlock-sluice-crank.flavor: Unbolted from the central canal floodgate when the lock-keeper ran out of pikes and decided forty pounds of greased iron worked better. The squared socket still fits a sluice-pin, though nowadays it mostly dents helmets.

uniq-stormtree-amber-staff.summary: Act III unique Mage rune staff dropped by Stormtrees, granting high Mind, large mana reserves, and mana regeneration.
uniq-stormtree-amber-staff.flavor: Split straight from the smoking heartwood of a lightning-struck coastal pine where sap cooked into glowing yellow glass. Holding it makes the hair on your forearms rise, and spells leap from its tip with a dry crack.

uniq-admiral-kael-spyglass.summary: Act III unique Mage spell-mirror dropped by Ash Weavers, adding Mind, accuracy, and strong fire resistance.
uniq-admiral-kael-spyglass.flavor: Salvaged from the scorched quarterdeck of a fire-ship outside Harborwatch, its brass rings warped slightly by burning pitch. Casters peer through the smoked lens to sight distant targets cleanly through thick harbor smoke.

uniq-drowned-choir-bell.summary: Act III unique Mage astral medallion dropped by Frost Bells, providing high mana, cold resistance, and mana regeneration.
uniq-drowned-choir-bell.flavor: A corroded bronze clapper pulled from a submerged abbey nave where the tide rings the bells twice a day. Hung on a wool cord, it stays wet with phantom spray and hums a steady, cold note that keeps mana flowing.

uniq-vesperion-organ-pipe.summary: Act III unique Mage crystal siphon wand from Vesperion, delivering high Mind, large mana, and potent lifesteal.
uniq-vesperion-organ-pipe.flavor: Cut from a tarnished silver reed-pipe that once droned across the black blockade's flagship. In a caster's hand, it drinks both breath and vitality from nearby foes, whistling softly whenever a spell lands true.

uniq-malrik-unforgiven-tome.summary: Act IV unique Mage cosmos eye dropped by Rift Moths, granting top Mind, massive mana, and high mana regeneration.
uniq-malrik-unforgiven-tome.flavor: Stuffed with cramped, furious margin-notes written in violet ink by a scholar who stopped believing in Collegium patience. Even half-charred from caldera sparks, the pages hum with disciplined, ruthless arcane arithmetic.

uniq-rowan-siege-helm.summary: Act IV unique Warrior dread crest helm dropped by Basalt Brutes, offering high armor, health, and fire resistance.
uniq-rowan-siege-helm.flavor: Bears a deep, palm-wide furrow across the left temple where a siege-stone glanced off during the defense of Greystone Wall. Captain Rowan refused to let the smith hammer the dent out, claiming it reminded him to keep his chin down.

uniq-anvilmaw-slag-maul.summary: Act IV unique Warrior obsidian greatmaul dropped by Anvilmaw Smiths, pairing top Body with fire resistance and critical chance.
uniq-anvilmaw-slag-maul.flavor: Wrenched from the cooling fingers of a cinderforge titan and lashed to an ironwood shaft with braided chain. The head still radiates a dull, dry warmth that chars leather straps and leaves smoking dents in basalt plate.

uniq-redglass-fletched-bow.summary: Act IV unique Archer windpiercer greatbow from Redglass Drakes, delivering top accuracy, critical chance, and speed.
uniq-redglass-fletched-bow.flavor: Laminated with thin splinters of volcanic redglass that flex without snapping in freezing highland drafts. Arrows loosed from its string hiss like hot iron plunged into a trough, striking before the target hears the draw.

uniq-gauntlet-pacifier-shield.summary: Act IV unique Warrior citadel aegis dropped by Dread Knights, offering top armor, high health, and fire and lightning resistance.
uniq-gauntlet-pacifier-shield.flavor: Forged from a melted iron portcullis after the First Checkpoint collapsed under mortar fire. Carrying it feels like hauling a cellar door uphill, yet nothing short of a direct caldera tremor can push its bearer back.

uniq-penitent-cinder-boots.summary: Act IV unique Warrior war greaves dropped by Cinderhorns, granting high armor, massive fire resistance, and speed.
uniq-penitent-cinder-boots.flavor: Lined with woven mineral cloth and thick iron soles studded with blunt nails for gripping hot volcanic scree. Scorched Penitents wore them across glowing slag trenches to prove their faith; sensible soldiers wear them to keep their toes.

uniq-hollow-monarch-blade.summary: Act IV unique Warrior zweihander dropped by Hollow Kings, combining high Body, lifesteal, critical chance, and cold resistance.
uniq-hollow-monarch-blade.flavor: A long, joyless greatsword stripped of every royal crest with a coarse iron file. Its balance sits heavy toward the point, built for sweeping aside entire ranks of retainers who still mistake a crown for authority.

uniq-threshold-scales-ring.summary: Act IV unique all-class vigor signet from questing, granting balanced Body, Mind, maximum health, and maximum mana.
uniq-threshold-scales-ring.flavor: Cast from twin strands of cold silver and blackened caldera iron twisted tightly around a blank central seal. Archivists note that the metal feels neither warm nor cold until its wearer finally chooses which road to walk.

uniq-ashkarath-crown-shard.summary: Act IV unique all-class spire medallion from the Cinder King, boosting Mind, Body, massive fire resistance, and critical chance.
uniq-ashkarath-crown-shard.flavor: Snapped from the jagged crest of an ancient furnace-crown and pierced with a simple iron wire so a mortal can wear it without blistering. It pulses with a slow, steady heat like a banked forge waiting for fresh bellows.

uniq-fen-poacher-yew.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Archer shortbow from bosses and bounties, adding solid damage, critical chance, and accuracy.
uniq-fen-poacher-yew.flavor: Cut from a stunted churchyard yew leaning over the Fenwick boundary ditch, seasoned in peat-smoke for two winters. Poachers swear it shoots quieter than ash, letting a hunter loose twice before the gamekeeper's dogs catch the scent.

uniq-tollkeeper-prod.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Archer recurve bow from bosses and bounties, granting damage, armor penetration, and extra reach.
uniq-tollkeeper-prod.flavor: Built to shoot cleanly from narrow stone arrow-slits across wide river fords and canyon mouths. The stiff limbs punish weak wrists, yet a seasoned marksman can pick a driver off a wagon seat before the horses reach the gate.

uniq-bracken-stalker-bow.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Archer composite bow from bosses and bounties, boosting damage, critical chance, and attack speed.
uniq-bracken-stalker-bow.flavor: Backed with pale desert horn and wrapped in oil-stained linen to keep out coastal spray. Scouts who survived Bracken Basin carved tiny wind-notches along the riser so they could adjust their aim by touch in the dark.

uniq-harbor-winch-arbalest.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Archer heavy arbalest from bosses and bounties, delivering high damage, armor penetration, and crit damage.
uniq-harbor-winch-arbalest.flavor: Salvaged from Oakhaven's outer seawall batteries and cut down to a stock a broad-shouldered trooper can actually carry. Winding the steel cord takes grit, yet its heavy bolts crack stone golems like dried walnuts.

uniq-caldera-gale-bow.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Archer greatbow from bosses and bounties, offering massive damage, high crit chance, and extended reach.
uniq-caldera-gale-bow.flavor: Strung with braided star-iron wire that refuses to slacken in volcanic updrafts. Archers who draw it on the high basalt ridges can loose across entire gorges, dropping enemy casters before they finish a single syllable.

uniq-peat-cowl.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Archer stalker hood from bosses and bounties, providing armor, evasion, and poison resistance.
uniq-peat-cowl.flavor: Dyed the exact dull brown of wet Fenwick sedge and lined with dried bog-myrtle to keep midges out of the eyes. Wearers disappear into roadside ditches the moment they pull the brim low.

uniq-viper-scale-jerkin.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Archer studded leather armor from bosses and bounties, adding armor, poison resistance, and dexterity.
uniq-viper-scale-jerkin.flavor: Stitched with overlapping strips of sun-cured desert viper hide that rattle faintly when you shoulder a bow. Caravan trackers prize it for turning away brush-thorns and spitting snakes alike.

uniq-gorse-brigandine.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Archer hardened brigandine from bosses and bounties, granting armor, critical chance, and movement speed.
uniq-gorse-brigandine.flavor: Small steel plates riveted inside tough coastal canvas dyed with yellow gorse-blossom. It lets a nimble marksman sprint across wet flagstones without clanking like a knight, while still stopping stray shrapnel.

uniq-drake-wing-cloak.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Archer dragon leather mantle from bosses and bounties, offering high armor, fire resistance, and evasion.
uniq-drake-wing-cloak.flavor: Cut from the leathery pinions of a highland redglass drake and oiled with sulfur tallow so it stays supple in dry heat. Sparks bounce harmlessly off the shoulders while its bearer slips through crossfire.

uniq-wyrm-stalker-mail.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Archer wyrmscale cuirass from bosses and bounties, delivering massive armor, all resistances, and dexterity.
uniq-wyrm-stalker-mail.flavor: Layered with iridescent scales pried from ancient caldera predators and laced with star-silver cord. Light as a hunting shirt yet tougher than forged plate, it is the pinnacle prize of any frontier marksman.

uniq-bog-treads.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Archer tracker treads from bosses and bounties, adding armor, brisk movement speed, and evasion.
uniq-bog-treads.flavor: Broad-soled moccasins stitched with waxed hemp so they do not suck off your heels in deep alkali mud. Hunters use them to cross soft flats where armored pursuers sink straight to the knee.

uniq-gale-striders.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Archer windrunner boots from bosses and bounties, granting high armor, fast movement speed, and dexterity.
uniq-gale-striders.flavor: Fitted with notched iron toe-plates for biting into wet coastal cliffs and loose basalt scree. Scouts wearing them seem to skim across broken ground with effortless balance.

uniq-string-slap-bracer.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Archer studded bracers from bosses and bounties, boosting armor, accuracy, and faster attack speed.
uniq-string-slap-bracer.flavor: Curved from boiled ox-horn and bound tight to the forearm so a heavy bowstring never bites the skin. Veteran archers swear the slick inner face shaves a fraction of a heartbeat off every draw.

uniq-night-blade-grips.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Archer shadowstrike grips from bosses and bounties, delivering high armor, crit chance, and crit damage.
uniq-night-blade-grips.flavor: Stolen from Baron Vane's private armory along with half his smuggling ciphers. The palms are dusted with fine rosin, locking bowstaves and dirks alike into a merciless, steady hold.

uniq-glass-eye-mask.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Archer shadow mask from bosses and bounties, granting high armor, sharp accuracy, and critical chance.
uniq-glass-eye-mask.flavor: Fitted with a single smoked-quartz monocle salvaged from a Collegium assay kit. It cuts through blowing ash and coastal glare, letting a marksman pick out weak rivets from fifty paces.

uniq-quarry-dusk-dirk.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Archer duelist poignard from bosses and bounties, offering solid damage, high crit chance, and armor pen.
uniq-quarry-dusk-dirk.flavor: A narrow, three-edged blade ground down from a broken quarry chisel for finishing armored foes up close. Scouts carry it tucked behind the quiver for moments when an ambush goes sideways.

uniq-parish-probate-wand.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Necromancer willow wand from bosses and bounties, adding damage, maximum mana, and lifesteal.
uniq-parish-probate-wand.flavor: Stamped with the Thornwick parish seal and used for decades to tap wooden coffins during pauper audits. In a necromancer's hand, that same dry tap calls overdue laborers right back out of the mud.

uniq-salt-yew-rod.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Necromancer yew wand from bosses and bounties, boosting damage, damage-over-time, and mana regeneration.
uniq-salt-yew-rod.flavor: Cured in Redmarsh brine until pale salt crystals bloomed permanently along the bark. Curses woven with this rod sting like an open cut rubbed with alkali dust, refusing to fade cleanly.

uniq-amber-debt-wand.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Necromancer amber focus wand from bosses and bounties, adding damage, minion health, and maximum mana.
uniq-amber-debt-wand.flavor: Capped with a lump of bog-amber containing a tiny, perfectly preserved silver tax-token. Raised skeletons bound to its glow hold together with stubborn, bureaucratic persistence.

uniq-ossuary-siphon.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Necromancer crystal siphon wand from bosses and bounties, offering high damage, lifesteal, and intellect.
uniq-ossuary-siphon.flavor: Turned from clouded crypt-quartz that drinks stray warmth straight out of the air. Every hex cast through the siphon pulls a cold trickle of stolen vigor back into its wielder's knuckles.

uniq-first-watch-archon.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Necromancer archon wand from bosses and bounties, delivering massive damage, intellect, and minion damage.
uniq-first-watch-archon.flavor: Recovered from the sealed alcoves of the Threshold where the First Watch kept silent tally over the dead. Beneath its pale iron tip, summoned ranks strike with the disciplined fury of an ancient legion.

uniq-abbey-censer-staff.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Necromancer ash staff from bosses and bounties, granting damage alongside cold and poison resistance.
uniq-abbey-censer-staff.flavor: Topped with a small perforated bronze cup that smells faintly of burnt rue and sea-salt. Coastal monks carried these staves into plague-cellars to keep both damp rot and restless spirits at arm's length.

uniq-pale-gallows-staff.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Necromancer thorn staff from bosses and bounties, offering massive damage, DoT power, and high health.
uniq-pale-gallows-staff.flavor: Hewn from a lightning-bleached root that grew beneath an old border gibbet. The wood is hard as iron and radiates a grim, stubborn vitality that feeds lingering curses through the fiercest endgame sieges.

uniq-mortuary-cassock.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Necromancer cloth robe from bosses and bounties, adding armor, maximum mana, and poison resistance.
uniq-mortuary-cassock.flavor: Tailored from coarse grey wool and stitched with deep pockets for chalk, tallow stubs, and burial tallies. It looks like humble parish garb, which keeps bandits from realizing who commands the skeletons behind them.

uniq-copper-stole-robe.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Necromancer weaver robe from bosses and bounties, granting armor, lightning resistance, and mana regen.
uniq-copper-stole-robe.flavor: Lined along the shoulders with braided copper thread salvaged from broken plateau wards. Clerks who wore it across Redmarsh could audit salt-vaults during static storms without singeing their parchment.

uniq-embalmer-shroud.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Necromancer mage robe from bosses and bounties, adding armor, high poison resistance, and minion health.
uniq-embalmer-shroud.flavor: Sealed with dark mineral bitumen and wrapped tight at the cuffs to keep out marsh spores and grave-damp. Raised servants standing near its bearer seem to draw strength from the bitter resin scent.

uniq-velvet-arbiter-mantle.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Necromancer velvet mantle from bosses and bounties, delivering high armor, all resistances, and intellect.
uniq-velvet-arbiter-mantle.flavor: Once worn by senior coastal oath-keepers who presided over maritime probate courts. Heavy, salt-stained, and lined with silver wire, it turns elemental fury aside with quiet, unshakeable dignity.

uniq-star-testament-robe.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Necromancer star robe from bosses and bounties, providing massive armor, high intellect, and large mana.
uniq-star-testament-robe.flavor: Embroidered with thousands of tiny, neat debt-clauses in pale silver thread that glow faintly in volcanic gloom. Few mortal casters can bear the weight of so many unfinished vows without losing their nerve.

uniq-ink-stained-wimple.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Necromancer sage cowl from bosses and bounties, granting armor, mind resistance, and mana regeneration.
uniq-ink-stained-wimple.flavor: Permanent blotches of gall-ink mark the brow where an exhausted scriptorium clerk rubbed his temples through sleepless nights. The linen shuts out battlefield panic and keeps a caster's focus razor-sharp.

uniq-apothecary-scale-focus.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Necromancer quartz focus from bosses and bounties, adding armor, intellect, and lifesteal.
uniq-apothecary-scale-focus.flavor: A small brass balance-beam mounted with chipped quartz pans, once used to weigh out bitter roots and silver filings. In combat, it weighs enemy vitality against the caster's own wounds and quietly tips the pan.

uniq-drowned-mirror.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Necromancer spell-mirror from bosses and bounties, offering high armor, cold resistance, and intellect.
uniq-drowned-mirror.flavor: Polished pewter backed with salted oak, salvaged from a coastal chapel swallowed by the tide. Its surface stays perpetually misted, reflecting freezing gales and hostile hexes back into the dark.

uniq-knuckle-tally-ring.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Necromancer bone ring from bosses and bounties, boosting maximum mana, DoT damage, and cold resistance.
uniq-knuckle-tally-ring.flavor: Carved from a bleached knuckle-bone and notched twelve times around the rim by a lower-parish bailiff. Cold to the touch, it lends a bitter edge to early hexes while keeping winter drizzle off the fingers.

uniq-alder-gate-cleaver.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Warrior iron sword from bosses and bounties, adding solid damage, armor penetration, and strength.
uniq-alder-gate-cleaver.flavor: Broad-bladed and nose-heavy, forged by Thornwick smiths specifically to hack through gnoll shields at the bridge barricades. Nothing about its balance invites fancy footwork—just clean, heavy cuts.

uniq-quarry-breaker-maul.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Warrior heavy morningstar from bosses and bounties, offering high damage, armor penetration, and strength.
uniq-quarry-breaker-maul.flavor: Bound with ironstone wedges pried from the Deep Quarry's third terrace. Its spiked head chews straight through riveted plate and granite hides, leaving behind a shower of sparks and crushed mail.

uniq-vanguard-flamberge.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Warrior flamberge from bosses and bounties, granting solid damage, critical chance, and extra health.
uniq-vanguard-flamberge.flavor: Issued to veteran trench-fighters who held the narrow mud passes between Oakhaven and the highland ridge. The undulating blade catches enemy polearms and wrenches them cleanly out of clumsy hands.

uniq-ironheart-executioner.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Warrior executioner blade from bosses and bounties, delivering high damage, strength, and armor penetration.
uniq-ironheart-executioner.flavor: A massive, square-tipped greatsword recovered from the frozen gatehouse of Ironheart Bastion. Its dark steel still carries a faint scent of dry red silt and splits heavy armor like kindling.

uniq-ashkarath-zweihander.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Warrior zweihander from bosses and bounties, offering massive damage, high strength, and fire resistance.
uniq-ashkarath-zweihander.flavor: Forged from obsidian-veined iron beside the inner dais of the caldera. Too heavy for ordinary levies to lift cleanly, in a master's hands it sweeps through dread knights and volcanic flames alike.

uniq-ravenwatch-pavise.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Warrior tower shield from bosses and bounties, providing high armor, strong block chance, and extra health.
uniq-ravenwatch-pavise.flavor: Tall enough to shelter a kneeling man from crown to boot, reinforced with iron strips salvaged from Ravenwatch's broken portcullis. Planted in the mud, it turns a storm of bolts into harmless clatter.

uniq-ironcamp-gothic.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Warrior full plate from bosses and bounties, granting massive armor, all resistances, and high vitality.
uniq-ironcamp-gothic.flavor: Forgemaster Vok hammered these fluted plates over open fissure-vents until the steel turned dark blue and shrugged off slag. Wearing it feels like stepping inside a walking fortress built for the Threshold.

uniq-rowan-basinet.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Warrior steel basinet from bosses and bounties, offering high armor, vitality, and fire resistance.
uniq-rowan-basinet.flavor: Fitted with a steep, pointed visor that deflects falling masonry and burning pitch from castle parapets. Greystone veterans swear you can hear siege drums better inside it than with bare ears.

uniq-collegium-ash-staff.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Mage rune staff from bosses and bounties, adding solid damage, intellect, and steady mana regeneration.
uniq-collegium-ash-staff.flavor: Carried out the back gate of the Collegium by a fellow expelled for questioning the Salt Tithe's arithmetic. The scorched ash wood channels spells cleanly without wasting a single drop of mana.

uniq-mint-assayer-staff.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Mage star staff from bosses and bounties, delivering high damage, lightning resistance, and critical chance.
uniq-mint-assayer-staff.flavor: Originally a heavy measuring rod inlaid with pure silver and copper rings for testing Border Mint bullion. Re-tuned for battle, it grounds stray lightning and snaps arcane bolts with surgical accuracy.

uniq-wardstone-quartz.summary: Tier-2 Act II unique Mage quartz focus from bosses and bounties, granting armor, maximum mana, and intellect.
uniq-wardstone-quartz.flavor: Ground into a palm-sized lens from a shattered Redmarsh spire, humming faintly whenever a storm builds on the horizon. Casters hold it up to read ley-currents as easily as a clerk reads a ledger.

uniq-astral-nav-sphere.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Mage astral sphere from bosses and bounties, providing armor, intellect, and steady mana regeneration.
uniq-astral-nav-sphere.flavor: Captured from a blockade navigator who steered through zero-visibility fog using brass rings and star-charts. Its nested hoops spin slowly on their own, keeping a caster's mind anchored amid chaos.

uniq-cosmos-caldera-eye.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Mage cosmos eye from bosses and bounties, delivering massive armor, top intellect, and huge maximum mana.
uniq-cosmos-caldera-eye.flavor: A dark, flawless orb pried from a pre-schism keystone overlooking the Obsidian Caldera. Gazing into its depths reveals the pulsing ley-web beneath the entire continent, feeding bottomless power to its bearer.

uniq-oakhaven-wire-hat.summary: Tier-4 Act IV unique Mage wizard hat from bosses and bounties, offering high armor, strong lightning resistance, and intellect.
uniq-oakhaven-wire-hat.flavor: Stiffened with braided copper wire around the wide brim so coastal squalls cannot fold it over the wearer's eyes. Storm-channelers joke that it looks ridiculous right up until it saves your scalp from a thunderbolt.

uniq-conclave-diadem.summary: Tier-5 endgame unique Mage archmage diadem from bosses and bounties, granting massive armor, top intellect, and high mana regen.
uniq-conclave-diadem.flavor: Forged from pale star-silver and set with a single cold prism that weighs almost nothing on the brow. Only senior assayers of the Spire Conclave ever wore its like during high-order deliberations.

uniq-galvanic-channelers.summary: Tier-3 Act III unique Mage velvet gloves from bosses and bounties, adding armor, faster cast speed, and maximum mana.
uniq-galvanic-channelers.flavor: Lined with dry oiled silk and tipped with tiny silver thimbles so arcanists can handle live ward-conduits without blistering. Gestures snap off cleanly, shaving precious moments off every volley.

uniq-alder-bridge-pike.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Warrior iron sword from bosses and bounties, granting early damage, armor, and extra block chance.
uniq-alder-bridge-pike.flavor: Ground down from a snapped bridge-pike after the third gnoll wave splintered the ash shaft. The heavy iron guard sits awkward in the hand, yet it parries crude axes better than most guild blades.

uniq-mill-wheel-shield.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Warrior wooden buckler from bosses and bounties, offering early armor, high block chance, and extra health.
uniq-mill-wheel-shield.flavor: Captain Garrick pried this iron-bound oak sluice-lid off the Greywood mill race when his own shield split in half. It still smells faintly of wet sawdust and river weeds, and refuses to crack.

uniq-ford-wader-greaves.summary: Tier-1 Act I unique Warrior leather boots from bosses and bounties, providing armor, extra health, and cold resistance.
uniq-ford-wader-greaves.flavor: Thigh-high river boots stuffed with dry straw and greased thick with tallow for standing watch in the Alder shallows. They squelch loudly on dry stone, yet no soldier who wears them ever loses a toe to frost.

aff2-pauper-inked.summary: Entry-level caster prefix for wands, staves, and robes that expands maximum mana for early skirmishes.
aff2-pauper-inked.flavor: Hedge-scribes who could not afford gilt silver mixed oak-gall with lampblack to trace mana-glyphs along cheap cloth and wood. The lines smudge in the rain and stain the wearer's cuffs grey, yet they still hold enough charge for an extra bolt.

aff2-quarry-hewn.summary: Second-tier weapon prefix that adds armor penetration to crack heavy hides and riveted frontier plate.
aff2-quarry-hewn.flavor: Shaped with blunt stone-splitting chisels in the Deep Quarry work-yards rather than polished on a guild wheel. The edge looks ugly and raw, yet it wedges neatly into iron seams where finer swords only glance off.

aff2-alkali-cured.summary: Defensive tier-2 armor prefix granting both fire and poison resistance for harsh Redmarsh marches.
aff2-alkali-cured.flavor: Caravan tanners soak thick oxhide in warm salt-pan brine and wood-ash until the leather turns pale and stiff as board. It smells sour in wet weather, though it shrugs off viper spit and brush-fires with quiet stubbornness.

aff2-salt-bitten.summary: Offensive tier-2 weapon prefix boosting raw damage and critical strike chance on close-quarters gear.
aff2-salt-bitten.flavor: Left overnight in brackish coastal tide-pools before grinding, salt-bitten steel develops microscopic pits along the bevel. Field surgeons hate stitching up the ragged wounds it leaves, which is precisely why raiders prize it.

aff2-copper-wound.summary: Caster prefix at tier 2 for staves, wands, and hats, providing lightning resistance and steady mana regeneration.
aff2-copper-wound.flavor: Thin coils of salvaged telegraph and smelter wire bound tightly around the haft or brim bleed stray sparks straight into the dirt. Storm-coast arcanists swear the faint hum keeps their minds awake during long wet watches.

aff2-fen-stalking.summary: Agile tier-2 prefix for boots and armor that raises both evasion and movement speed across rough ground.
aff2-fen-stalking.flavor: Greased with otter-fat and stripped of jingling brass buckles by poachers who worked the Greywood ditches. Wearing it feels like trading heavy parade kit for a second skin that slips cleanly past clutching roots and clumsy spears.

aff2-notarized.summary: Hex-focused tier-2 prefix for wands, rings, and amulets that amplifies damage-over-time effects.
aff2-notarized.flavor: Stamped with a tiny lead probate seal by clerks who treated battlefield curses like overdue tax assessments. Once a target is marked by a notarized focus, the affliction settles in like a lien that refuses to be discharged early.

aff2-annealed.summary: Sturdy tier-3 prefix for armor and shields that grants both flat physical armor and extra maximum health.
aff2-annealed.flavor: Heated slow in charcoal banks and cooled overnight in dry ash so the metal loses its brittle temper. Annealed plates bend slightly under a heavy maul instead of shattering into the wearer's ribs, earning every copper of smithy pay.

aff2-bodkin-tipped.summary: Armor-piercing tier-3 bow prefix adding flat damage and penetration against heavily plated targets.
aff2-bodkin-tipped.flavor: Oakhaven fletchers draw four-sided iron points specifically for punching through linked mail at fifty paces. A bow fitted and tuned for bodkin shafts wastes no energy on wide cuts, driving straight into the meat behind the steel.

aff2-galvanic.summary: Crackling tier-3 prefix for staves and wands that adds lightning damage and faster casting speed.
aff2-galvanic.flavor: Calibrated with slivers of plateau quartz that snap audibly whenever the bearer lifts a hand. The static jolt hurries the caster's gestures along, though careless apprentices often end up with singed knuckles and standing hair.

aff2-bitumen-coated.summary: Protective tier-3 armor prefix delivering high poison resistance alongside a solid boost to maximum health.
aff2-bitumen-coated.flavor: Brushed warm with black mineral pitch dredged from sunken Third-Dynasty quays. The tarry sheen ruins any tunic worn underneath, yet it seals out marsh spores, bog-venom, and freezing ditch water for weeks on end.

aff2-windlass-spanned.summary: Heavy tier-3 bow prefix that boosts base damage and critical strike damage for deliberate marksmen.
aff2-windlass-spanned.flavor: Reinforced with iron stirrups and gear-notches borrowed from harborwall siege prods. Drawing it takes iron shoulders and patience, yet a single clean release hits with enough force to knock a shielded raider off his heels.

aff2-indentured.summary: Summoner-oriented tier-3 prefix for wands, robes, and amulets that boosts minion health and maximum mana.
aff2-indentured.flavor: Woven with narrow slips of stamped contract parchment tucked straight into the lining. Raised servants bound through an indentured focus stay upright far longer, refusing to collapse until their clerk signs off on the shift.

aff2-meteor-forged.summary: High-impact tier-4 weapon prefix granting heavy damage and strong armor penetration against elite foes.
aff2-meteor-forged.flavor: Hammered from dark sky-iron pried out of highland craters where ordinary coal fires barely soften the ore. Smiths ruin two hammers shaping a single blade, yet the finished edge shears through basalt plates like soft pine.

aff2-slag-quenched.summary: Heat-hardened tier-4 prefix for armor and shields adding substantial armor and strong fire resistance.
aff2-slag-quenched.flavor: Plunged red-hot into molten volcanic dross inside Ironcamp's deepest sheds until a dull glassy crust seals the steel. Soldiers wearing slag-quenched harness walk through burning pitch trenches smelling of sulfur and unbothered by flame.

aff2-pre-schism.summary: Scholarly tier-4 prefix for staves, wands, and hats that boosts intellect and high mana regeneration.
aff2-pre-schism.flavor: Salvaged from libraries sealed before the Caldera fissures ever cracked the southern horizon. The fine silver inlay hums with a clean, orderly cadence that modern Collegium workshops have tried and failed to copy for a century.

aff2-oath-bound.summary: Commanding tier-4 prefix for robes, amulets, and rings that increases minion damage and all resistances.
aff2-oath-bound.flavor: Inscribed with the double-witness vows of the coastal abbeys, binding servant and master under a single iron rubric. Skeletons and spirits tethered to oath-bound gear strike with grim precision while elemental blasts slide off the bearer.

aff2-smoke-veiled.summary: Elusive tier-4 prefix for armor, boots, and hats combining high evasion with sharper critical strike chance.
aff2-smoke-veiled.flavor: Cured over smoldering peat-fires and rubbed with caldera soot until the fabric drinks torchlight instead of reflecting it. Scouts slip through crossfire like drifting chimney haze, landing cruel strikes before anyone spots their silhouette.

aff2-brine-tempered.summary: Coastal tier-4 prefix for shields and armor granting high cold resistance and improved block chance.
aff2-brine-tempered.flavor: Quenched in freezing Western Sea surf while still cherry-red on the tongs, giving the iron a mottled, salt-hardened grain. Harborwatch marines trust brine-tempered shields to turn away both sleet-gales and heavy boarding axes.

aff2-sovereign.summary: Pinnacle tier-5 weapon prefix delivering massive damage, critical strike chance, and raw strength.
aff2-sovereign.flavor: Stamped with the high-assay crest once reserved for marshals who commanded entire frontier legions. Holding a sovereign blade carries an unmistakable authority, turning every measured swing into a verdict that breaks shields and morale alike.

aff2-anchor-sealed.summary: Endgame tier-5 prefix for armor and shields providing massive physical armor and broad all-resistances.
aff2-anchor-sealed.flavor: Bound with microscopic wards copied directly from the Threshold's great stability pylons. Men clad in anchor-sealed plate stand unmoved amid volcanic shockwaves and elemental barrages that flatten ordinary fortifications.

aff2-caldera-born.summary: Volcanic tier-5 prefix for staves, wands, and robes boosting fire spell damage and strong fire resistance.
aff2-caldera-born.flavor: Tempered over open magma vents where the air shimmers thick enough to blister bare cheeks. Arcanists who carry caldera-born gear drink the furnace heat straight into their spells while remaining cool as slate inside their sleeves.

aff2-first-watch.summary: Resolute tier-5 prefix for armor, hats, and amulets granting huge maximum health and strong morale resistance.
aff2-first-watch.flavor: Modeled on the stern, unadorned kit of the ancient sentinels who held the inner passes before the Crown existed. Wearers simply refuse to panic or fold, standing their post long after lesser companies would have broken.

aff2-foreclosing.summary: Ruthless tier-5 weapon prefix combining heavy damage with potent lifesteal on every landed blow.
aff2-foreclosing.flavor: Quartermasters whisper that these blades were struck for the Synod's most feared debt-collectors. Every cut collects vitality straight from the enemy's veins, keeping the wielder relentlessly upright until the last account is settled.

aff2-star-iron.summary: Rare tier-5 prefix for weapons and armor pairing high all-resistances with devastating critical damage.
aff2-star-iron.flavor: Smelted from pale meteoric ingots that ring like abbey bells when tapped with a fingernail. Star-iron refuses to rust in bog-water or soften in caldera heat, rewarding clean strikes with bone-splitting precision.

aff2-of-the-ford.summary: Early tier-1 suffix for boots and rings adding light cold resistance and a modest health boost.
aff2-of-the-ford.flavor: Stitched and greased by Alder River ferrymen who spend eight months of the year knee-deep in freezing runoff. Nothing fancy sits on the rim, just honest protection that keeps northern levies marching through November sleet.

aff2-of-tallies.summary: Practical tier-1 suffix for rings and amulets that increases gold recovered from fallen foes.
aff2-of-tallies.flavor: Notched along the inner band like a Thornwick tax-stick so every copper coin gets counted twice. Mercenaries mock the clerks who wear them right up until payday, when the tallied purse always clinks heavier than theirs.

aff2-of-dry-socks.summary: Humble tier-1 boot suffix that reduces fatigue buildup during long marches across wet terrain.
aff2-of-dry-socks.flavor: Every veteran on the Alder front knows you can fight hungry and you can fight bruised, but trench-rot ends a campaign faster than gnolls. Boots bearing this homely blessing keep a soldier's pace steady through ankle-deep mire.

aff2-of-the-ditch.summary: Gritty tier-1 suffix for armor and shields providing extra armor and a small boost to maximum health.
aff2-of-the-ditch.flavor: Named for the muddy earthworks where Thornwick militia learned to duck arrows and trade blows from the knee. Gear of the ditch looks battered before it leaves the forge, yet it keeps green troops alive through their first ambush.

aff2-of-goose-fletch.summary: Steady tier-1 suffix for bows and gloves that sharpens accuracy in wind and drizzle.
aff2-of-goose-fletch.flavor: Grey river-geese grow stiff, oil-rich wing feathers that refuse to droop when fog rolls off the reeds. Archers trade spare rations for fletching charms, knowing a clean release beats a heavy draw every time.

aff2-of-gall-ink.summary: Apprentice tier-1 suffix for wands and rings that grants a useful boost to maximum mana.
aff2-of-gall-ink.flavor: Prepared from crushed oak-galls and copperas in damp parish back-rooms where paper costs more than bread. The dark stain never washes off the fingers, yet it anchors enough spare mana for an extra ward or bolt.

aff2-of-the-cistern.summary: Desert tier-2 suffix for amulets and rings granting fire resistance and a healthy maximum HP bonus.
aff2-of-the-cistern.flavor: Stamped with the cooling-arch emblem of Ironheart's legendary mountain reservoirs. Redmarsh travelers clutch these trinkets under the white noon glare, swearing the metal stays cool against their chest even when the waterskins run dry.

aff2-of-sinew.summary: Nimble tier-2 suffix for gloves and bows boosting dexterity and faster attack speed.
aff2-of-sinew.flavor: Backed with dried horn and braided ox-tendon cured in warm alkali wind until it snaps like a whip. Marksmen and duelists prize the crisp rebound, loosing two clean shots before an armored foe can close the gap.

aff2-of-arrears.summary: Grim tier-2 suffix for wands and rings that increases damage-over-time and expands maximum mana.
aff2-of-arrears.flavor: Born in the probate offices of the lower parishes, where late payments carried penalties harsher than the gallows. Curses cast through gear of arrears bite harder with every passing heartbeat, draining foes who try to stall.

aff2-of-the-pick.summary: Breaching tier-2 weapon suffix adding armor penetration and raw strength for cracking tough hides.
aff2-of-the-pick.flavor: Weighted like a Deep Quarry miner's ironstone hammer so the point concentrates all the shoulder's force onto a single spot. Basalt shells and riveted breastplates alike split cleanly when struck with quarry discipline.

aff2-of-vinegar.summary: Apothecary tier-2 suffix for armor and amulets granting poison resistance and stronger healing received.
aff2-of-vinegar.flavor: Field medics in Redmarsh boil everything from bandages to drinking water with sharp sour vinegar to kill marsh-rot. Gear cured in the same astringent bath turns back venom and helps poultices take hold faster.

aff2-of-the-parapet.summary: Fortified tier-2 suffix for shields and hats that boosts missile resistance and block chance.
aff2-of-the-parapet.flavor: Designed for wall-sentries who spend entire shifts peering over notched stonework while canyon snipers try to take their ears off. A tilted brim and a high rim turn a storm of hornbow shafts into harmless clatter.

aff2-of-the-sluice.summary: Waterproof tier-3 suffix for armor and boots delivering high cold resistance and extra armor.
aff2-of-the-sluice.flavor: Worn by canal lock-keepers who winch heavy iron gates in chest-deep meltwater without losing their grip. Thick oilcloth and cold-hammered iron plates turn freezing spray and stray shrapnel aside with equal indifference.

aff2-of-the-windlass.summary: Precision tier-3 suffix for bows and gloves boosting critical strike damage and dexterity.
aff2-of-the-windlass.flavor: Calibrated with tiny brass ratchets copied from Oakhaven's heavy harborwall crossbows. Every draw locks cleanly to the exact same anchor point, letting steady marksmen punch straight through weak seams in enemy plate.

aff2-of-probate.summary: Administrative tier-3 suffix for wands, staves, and amulets raising minion health and intellect.
aff2-of-probate.flavor: Certified under the Third Dynasty's strictest mortuary statutes, where not even a rib bone goes unaccounted for. Necromancers using probate foci field sturdier skeletal ranks that hold formation like seasoned regulars.

aff2-of-conduction.summary: Storm-ready tier-3 suffix for rings and hats offering high lightning resistance and mana regeneration.
aff2-of-conduction.flavor: Wound with bright annealed copper wire that channels stray static out of the scalp and back into the caster's reserve. Storm-coast mages wear it proudly during gale-force watches when ordinary brass clasps throw sparks.

aff2-of-the-keel.summary: Resilient tier-3 suffix for armor and shields granting substantial maximum health and vitality.
aff2-of-the-keel.flavor: Built by Oakhaven shipwrights who judged every breastplate the way they judged an ironwood hull-beam: will it hold when the sea slams it? Soldiers wearing keel-marked kit take punishing charges without cracking.

aff2-of-sightlines.summary: Scouting tier-3 suffix for hats and bows that expands vision range and sharply improves accuracy.
aff2-of-sightlines.flavor: Fitted with smoked-glass brow shades and range-notches favored by coastal falconers and lookout corporals. Spotting an ambush two paces sooner in thick fog or blowing ash is often the whole difference between victory and a shallow grave.

aff2-of-the-fissure.summary: Scorching tier-4 suffix for weapons and armor combining high fire resistance with strong bonus damage.
aff2-of-the-fissure.flavor: Quenched in the sulfurous steam rising from caldera cracks where iron glows dull red before it even touches the forge. Gear of the fissure bites hot into enemy flesh while keeping the bearer safe from volcanic vents.

aff2-of-the-witness.summary: Serene tier-4 suffix for amulets and robes granting high mind resistance and stronger healing power.
aff2-of-the-witness.flavor: Carried by abbey oath-keepers who stood calm amid panicked retreats and screaming field infirmaries. A clear mind keeps the surgeon's hand steady and stretches every drop of restorative magic across the wounded line.

aff2-of-the-bailiff.summary: Extracting tier-4 suffix for weapons and rings pairing lifesteal with a solid strength bonus.
aff2-of-the-bailiff.flavor: The Crown's senior bailiffs never left a parish empty-handed, and mercenaries who copied their iron sigils follow the same rule. Each heavy strike wrings fresh stamina out of the foe to sustain the assault.

aff2-of-the-gauntlet.summary: Siege-grade tier-4 suffix for armor and boots delivering high physical armor and heavy maximum health.
aff2-of-the-gauntlet.flavor: Tested in the brutal kill-zone canyons outside the Obsidian Caldera where crossfire turns ordinary plate into colanders. Only the thickest layered steel survives the march, earning this grim title from the sappers who made it through.

aff2-of-the-leyline.summary: Channeling tier-4 suffix for staves, wands, and rings adding large maximum mana and faster cast speed.
aff2-of-the-leyline.flavor: Tuned directly to the deep arcane currents pulsing beneath Thornvael's fractured bedrock. Casters attuned to the leyline weave complex barrages effortlessly, their fingers tracing bright sigils faster than archers can nock.

aff2-of-the-cairn.summary: Enduring tier-4 suffix for shields and amulets providing broad all-resistances and extra vitality.
aff2-of-the-cairn.flavor: Carved from the grey highland boundary stones that have weathered centuries of frost, fire, and border wars without toppling. Gear of the cairn lends that same stubborn permanence to anyone holding a lonely ridge.

aff2-of-the-threshold.summary: Apex tier-5 suffix for armor and amulets granting high all-resistances and massive maximum health.
aff2-of-the-threshold.flavor: Inscribed with the solemn lintel-glyphs guarding the deepest chambers beneath the volcanic peaks. Few mortals ever earn a threshold seal, and those who wear it endure elemental fury that would vaporize ordinary troops.

aff2-of-liquidation.summary: Lethal tier-5 weapon suffix delivering high critical strike chance and devastating critical damage.
aff2-of-liquidation.flavor: The final, merciless entry in any quartermaster's book when an account is closed for good. Weapons marked for liquidation find every soft joint and cracked scale, ending protracted duels in a single catastrophic stroke.

aff2-of-the-dais.summary: Commanding tier-5 suffix for armor and rings combining strength, vitality, and heavy physical armor.
aff2-of-the-dais.flavor: Forged for the elite honor guard who once stood motionless beside the ancient basalt platforms of the caldera. Every plate sits with balanced authority, turning a veteran captain into an immovable pillar on the battlefield.

aff2-of-the-void-eye.summary: Masterwork tier-5 suffix for staves, hats, and amulets granting top intellect and swift mana regeneration.
aff2-of-the-void-eye.flavor: Cut with dark, reflective facets that seem to stare straight through smoke, fog, and illusion. Senior archons prize void-eye craft for keeping their mana wells brimming even during the fiercest endgame sieges.

aff2-of-the-unbroken.summary: Bastion tier-5 suffix for shields and armor combining high block chance with massive maximum health.
aff2-of-the-unbroken.flavor: Dedicated to the rearguard companies who held burning piers and collapsed walls without taking a single step back. Gear of the unbroken absorbs punishing blows from titans and dread knights without yielding an inch.

aff2-of-reckoning.summary: Decisive tier-5 weapon suffix delivering heavy raw damage alongside high armor penetration.
aff2-of-reckoning.flavor: Nothing subtle about this forge-mark—it is hammered onto endgame steel meant to settle four acts of blood and betrayal. Plate, stone hide, and ancient wards alike split open when reckoning finally arrives.

sim-prefix-jagged.summary: Low-tier weapon prefix (tiers 1–2) that adds a small, reliable flat damage increase.
sim-prefix-jagged.flavor: Roughly filed by border levies who lacked proper whetstones and settled for raw, tearing teeth along the blade. It looks disgraceful at inspection, yet a jagged edge chews through gnoll hide far better than dull iron.

sim-prefix-serrated.summary: Mid-early weapon prefix (tiers 2–3) boosting both flat damage and strike accuracy.
sim-prefix-serrated.flavor: Cut with deliberate saw-notches by Greywood millwrights turned armorer during the northern shortages. The toothed edge catches cleanly on leather straps and bone, steadying blows that might otherwise skid wide.

sim-prefix-keen.summary: Upper-tier weapon prefix (tiers 3–4) granting solid bonus damage and sharpened accuracy.
sim-prefix-keen.flavor: Honed patiently on oiled river-slate until the bevel can shave a dry willow twig without catching. Experienced duelists and harbor marines pay extra for keen steel that rewards clean footwork.

sim-prefix-cruel.summary: High-tier weapon prefix (tiers 4–5) delivering heavy bonus damage and strong accuracy.
sim-prefix-cruel.flavor: Forged with wicked weight distribution and needle-fine geometry by ironcamp smiths who stopped caring about chivalry years ago. Cruel weapons bite deep through mail and marrow, ending skirmishes before the enemy can rally.

sim-prefix-stout.summary: Early defensive prefix (tiers 1–2) for armor, shields, helms, and boots adding defense and absorption.
sim-prefix-stout.flavor: Thick-cut hide and doubled iron straps assembled in Thornwick's crowded repair sheds. Stout gear adds a little groan to your knees on steep hills, yet it keeps stray arrows from ruining your week.

sim-prefix-hardened.summary: Mid-early defensive prefix (tiers 2–3) for protective gear boosting defense and damage absorption.
sim-prefix-hardened.flavor: Case-hardened in bone-charcoal and salt brine until the outer skin rings sharp under a knuckle-tap. Caravan guards trust hardened kit to weather canyon ambushes without splitting at the rivets.

sim-prefix-tempered.summary: Advanced defensive prefix (tiers 3–4) for armor, shields, helms, and boots adding strong defense and absorption.
sim-prefix-tempered.flavor: Drawn back carefully over glowing coals until the steel turns straw-blue, balancing toughness against brittle cracking. Oakhaven armorers stamp tempered harness for veterans who expect to trade blows with stone golems.

sim-prefix-indomitable.summary: Endgame defensive prefix (tiers 4–5) for protective gear delivering high defense and heavy absorption.
sim-prefix-indomitable.flavor: Layered with dark caldera ironstone and riveted tight enough to outlast the soldier inside it. Indomitable harness turns glancing hits into sparks and absorbs direct impacts that would pulp ordinary plate.

sim-prefix-glowing.summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light damage bonus.
sim-prefix-glowing.flavor: Warm as a pocketed hearth-stone, glowing craft carries the faint orange shimmer of beginner pyromancy. Scouts dislike how it gives away a camp in the dark, though nobody refuses the extra punch in a brawl.

sim-prefix-fiery.summary: Mid-tier universal prefix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot to grant a steady damage increase.
sim-prefix-fiery.flavor: Touched by kiln-fire runes that leave tiny soot-marks on cloth and make iron hilts pleasantly warm in freezing rain. Fiery gear lends crisp thermal bite to strikes across the marshes and wastes.

sim-prefix-volcanic.summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot for substantial bonus damage.
sim-prefix-volcanic.flavor: Steeped in the roaring drafts of the Obsidian Caldera until veins of molten orange pulse beneath the finish. Every piece radiates dry, impatient heat that scorches enemy hides on contact.

sim-prefix-chilly.summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light defense bonus.
sim-prefix-chilly.flavor: Cool to the touch even at high noon, carrying a thin trace of northern river-frost. Soldiers marching out of Thornwick enjoy how chilly trim stiffens soft leather against clumsy slashes.

sim-prefix-glacial.summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot providing strong defense and absorption.
sim-prefix-glacial.flavor: Encrusted with pale, permanent rime harvested from ancient alpine cisterns. Glacial gear hardens air and metal alike into a rigid barrier that blunts heavy swings and laughs at volcanic heat.

sim-prefix-breezy.summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to grant a small accuracy boost.
sim-prefix-breezy.flavor: Trimmed with light wind-charms popular among ferrymen and road scouts. A breezy balance takes the sluggish drag out of cheap frontier kit, helping tired hands land cleaner strikes.

sim-prefix-storming.summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot adding bonus damage and accuracy.
sim-prefix-storming.flavor: Humming with bottled coastal squalls that make nearby hair stand on end. Storming gear guides blows with crisp, snapping urgency, striking true even through blinding dust or driving rain.

sim-prefix-earthen.summary: Early universal prefix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light damage absorption bonus.
sim-prefix-earthen.flavor: Rubbed with dense iron-clay and grounded with river-pebble charms by practical border artisans. Earthen gear feels stubbornly solid, taking the sting out of clubs and falling scree.

sim-prefix-granite.summary: High-tier universal prefix (tiers 3–5) usable on any gear slot delivering solid defense and absorption.
sim-prefix-granite.flavor: Bound with dense quarry-stone wards that lend ordinary cloth and steel the unyielding mass of a mountain bluff. Frontliners clad in granite-marked gear hold narrow passes like living masonry.

sim-prefix-glimmering.summary: Early arcane prefix (tiers 1–2) for weapons, helms, rings, and amulets adding mana and spell power.
sim-prefix-glimmering.flavor: Dusted with crushed river-mica that catches lantern-light with a pale silver sheen. Hedge-mages favor glimmering trinkets for stretching a small mana pool through early frontier skirmishes.

sim-prefix-luminescent.summary: Advanced arcane prefix (tiers 3–4) for caster slots granting substantial mana and spell power.
sim-prefix-luminescent.flavor: Etched with fine Collegium prism-lines that pulse softly whenever ley-currents shift nearby. Luminescent gear turns modest incantations into crisp, blinding volleys that scatter packed raiders.

sim-prefix-celestial.summary: Endgame arcane prefix (tiers 4–5) for caster slots delivering huge mana reserves and high spell power.
sim-prefix-celestial.flavor: Aligned to pre-schism star charts preserved in the Spire Conclave's highest galleries. Holding celestial-crafted gear feels like tapping a bottomless cold well of pure arcane authority.

sim-suffix-of-striking.summary: Early offensive suffix (tiers 1–2) for weapons, rings, and amulets adding a modest damage bonus.
sim-suffix-of-striking.flavor: Balanced forward toward the tip or knuckle so every swing carries a little extra snap. Thornwick drill-sergeants hand out trinkets of striking to recruits who hit too timidly in line drills.

sim-suffix-of-carnage.summary: Mid-tier offensive suffix (tiers 2–3) for weapons, rings, and amulets granting solid bonus damage.
sim-suffix-of-carnage.flavor: Forged during the brutal Redmarsh caravan wars when polite skirmishes gave way to desperate survival. Gear of carnage is notched, heavy, and unapologetically built to break enemy lines fast.

sim-suffix-of-slaughter.summary: Endgame offensive suffix (tiers 4–5) for weapons, rings, and amulets delivering heavy bonus damage.
sim-suffix-of-slaughter.flavor: Notched with tally-marks by veteran breachers who marched from the burning harbor straight into the caldera. Every strike lands with pitiless weight, turning armored packs into scattered scrap.

sim-suffix-of-the-ox.summary: Early vitality suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a small pool of maximum health.
sim-suffix-of-the-ox.flavor: Named for the patient, thick-necked haulers that pull timber carts out of Greywood mud. Wearing gear of the ox lends a little of that stubborn endurance to green soldiers on their first campaign.

sim-suffix-of-the-bear.summary: Mid-tier vitality suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot to grant a solid maximum health boost.
sim-suffix-of-the-bear.flavor: Northern trappers stitch bone-beads and thick hide bindings onto gear to mimic the rugged bulk of highland bears. It keeps a soldier standing through ugly blows that would fold a slighter man.

sim-suffix-of-the-behemoth.summary: Endgame vitality suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering a large maximum health increase.
sim-suffix-of-the-behemoth.flavor: Inspired by the bleached leviathan ribs towering over Redmarsh Outpost. Veterans clad in gear of the behemoth absorb punishing siege hits with grim calm, refusing to yield ground to titans.

sim-suffix-of-dexterity.summary: Early precision suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to provide a light accuracy bonus.
sim-suffix-of-dexterity.flavor: Laced snug and stripped of clumsy excess leather by scouts who needed steady hands in the rain. Even a minor boost to footwork and aim turns wild frontier swings into clean hits.

sim-suffix-of-grace.summary: Mid-tier agility suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot granting both accuracy and defense.
sim-suffix-of-grace.flavor: Tailored for nimble skirmishers and boarding marines who survive by slipping past heavy blades rather than catching them on their ribs. Every buckle sits balanced so the wearer turns on a copper piece.

sim-suffix-of-nirvana.summary: Endgame mastery suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot providing high accuracy and solid defense.
sim-suffix-of-nirvana.flavor: Worn by coastal abbey duelists who trained until battlefield chaos felt as quiet as an empty scriptorium. Movements flow without hesitation, guiding strikes cleanly through gaps while dodging counterblows.

sim-suffix-of-thought.summary: Early mental suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot to add a light bonus to maximum mana.
sim-suffix-of-thought.flavor: Inscribed with simple memory-knots used by parish clerks to keep their figures straight on noisy market days. Apprentice casters prize it for squeezing one more spell out of a wet skirmish.

sim-suffix-of-wisdom.summary: Mid-tier mental suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot granting a solid maximum mana reserve.
sim-suffix-of-wisdom.flavor: Favored by veteran hedge-scholars and quartermaster-arcanists who learned that running dry mid-battle is worse than dropping your sword. It steadies the mind and deepens the caster's reserve.

sim-suffix-of-the-archmage.summary: Endgame arcane suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering high mana and bonus spell power.
sim-suffix-of-the-archmage.flavor: Bearing the high geometric seal of the Spire Conclave's inner circle, gear of the archmage hums with disciplined power. Few pieces survive outside locked vaults, and every caster on the Border covets them.

sim-suffix-of-health.summary: Early restorative suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot adding maximum health and light regeneration.
sim-suffix-of-health.flavor: Rubbed with dried willow-bark and fen-herbs by camp healers who never had enough clean linen. It keeps minor cuts knitting together on the march so squads stay fit between towns.

sim-suffix-of-regeneration.summary: Mid-tier restorative suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot boosting maximum health and steady healing.
sim-suffix-of-regeneration.flavor: Infused with bitter apothecary salts that keep blood moving cleanly even through alkali fever and damp chill. Frontliners swear gear of regeneration saves half their belt potions over a long siege.

sim-suffix-of-immortality.summary: Endgame restorative suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot delivering high health and rapid regeneration.
sim-suffix-of-immortality.flavor: Bound with stubborn First-Dynasty vitality seals that refuse to let a battered soldier stay down. Even amid volcanic ash and dread-knight charges, wounds close fast enough to unnerve anyone watching.

sim-suffix-of-protection.summary: Early defensive suffix (tiers 1–2) usable on any gear slot granting an elemental or attribute ward.
sim-suffix-of-protection.flavor: Scratched with basic roadside shrine-marks by cautious travelers before crossing the Alder bridges. It offers modest shelter against frontier hazards, which is still far better than marching out bare.

sim-suffix-of-warding.summary: Mid-tier defensive suffix (tiers 2–4) usable on any gear slot providing a stronger elemental or attribute ward.
sim-suffix-of-warding.flavor: Blessed by abbey scribes and Collegium assayers to blunt the harsh elements of Redmarsh and the Iron Coast. Veterans rely on warding seals whenever lightning scarabs or frost-bells appear.

sim-suffix-of-the-aegis.summary: Endgame defensive suffix (tiers 4–5) usable on any gear slot granting a high-tier elemental or attribute ward.
sim-suffix-of-the-aegis.flavor: Modelled on the ancient bastion seals that kept coastal citadels standing through storm and siege. Gear of the aegis wraps its bearer in quiet, reliable resilience fit for the Threshold itself.

mag-temp-4.summary: Tier-2 Mage Tempest passive (max rank 4) requiring Static Lattice, extending chill duration on enemies.
mag-temp-4.flavor: Northern casters learned to lace their frost spells with river-mist so the rime clings to wool and leather long after the bolt fades. A chilled raider swings like he is wading through waist-deep mire, giving the vanguard plenty of time to finish him.

mag-temp-5.summary: Tier-3 Mage Tempest passive (max rank 3) requiring Galvanic Arc, amplifying storm damage against wet targets.
mag-temp-5.flavor: Thornwick's endless drizzle is a misery for bowmen and a gift for tempest arcanists. Soaked mail conducts lightning straight to the ribs, turning a routine river-ford skirmish into a brisk lesson in Collegium physics.

mag-temp-6.summary: Tier-3 Mage Tempest active skill (max rank 3) requiring Rime Coat, unleashing a freezing nova around the caster.
mag-temp-6.flavor: When briar-hounds break past the pike line, a smart mage does not try to outrun them in wet robes. Slamming a ring of flash-frost into the mud locks the whole pack in brittle ice long enough to step back and reload.

mag-temp-7.summary: Tier-4 Mage Tempest passive (max rank 4) requiring Wet Conduction, significantly expanding the caster's maximum mana.
mag-temp-7.flavor: Inspired by the copper-bound leyden horns mounted on Redmarsh wardstones, this technique stores surplus ambient charge inside the caster's own focus. The air around them smells permanently of storm-ozone and wet iron.

mag-temp-8.summary: Tier-4 Mage Tempest capstone (max rank 2) requiring Hoarfrost Ring, conjuring a slow-moving orb that zaps nearby foes.
mag-temp-8.flavor: Unstable, humming, and deeply unpopular with friendly pike-sergeants, a drifting sphere of bottled lightning chews through packed formations at its own leisurely pace. Even seasoned dread knights break ranks rather than stand beside it.

mag-ward-1.summary: Tier-1 Mage Wardcraft passive (max rank 5) that increases maximum mana for sustained spellcasting.
mag-ward-1.flavor: First-year Collegium students spend months drawing clean circles on slate floors with cheap border chalk. Sloppy angles leak mana into the floorboards; crisp geometry keeps enough reserve in the tank for a second volley.

mag-ward-2.summary: Tier-1 Mage Wardcraft passive (max rank 5) that steadily boosts mana regeneration during combat.
mag-ward-2.flavor: Experienced scribes never crowd their ink to the edge of the page, leaving wide margins for corrections and breath. Applying the same discipline to spellcraft lets an arcanist recover focus between casts without gulping blue draughts.

mag-ward-3.summary: Tier-2 Mage Wardcraft active skill (max rank 4) requiring Chalk Geometry, wrapping the caster in a damage-absorbing ward.
mag-ward-3.flavor: A thin shell of shimmering air that turns aside stray quill-fiend spines and glancing arrows without weighing down the shoulders. It shatters loudly when overloaded, which at least gives the mage fair warning to move.

mag-ward-4.summary: Tier-2 Mage Wardcraft passive (max rank 4) requiring Vellum Margin, improving resistance against spell interruption.
mag-ward-4.flavor: Anyone can recite a ward-verse in a quiet library; doing it while a thorn-boar slams into your frontliner takes iron nerves. Steady breathing and a flat tone keep the syllables unbroken even when mud splashes across the page.

mag-ward-5.summary: Tier-3 Mage Wardcraft active skill (max rank 3) requiring Aether Ward, dispelling hostile curses and enchantments.
mag-ward-5.flavor: Fen hexers and ash weavers rely on nasty little knots of malice to rot a squad from the inside out. A sharp tug on the loose thread unravels their handiwork in a heartbeat, leaving them with nothing but a crooked stick.

mag-ward-6.summary: Tier-3 Mage Wardcraft passive (max rank 3) requiring Steady Cadence, granting a chance for spells to cost no mana.
mag-ward-6.flavor: Collegium auditors hate waste in any form, whether spilled lamp oil or stray ley-charge. By catching the rebound from a finished cast, a thrifty wardcrafter occasionally fires a follow-up spell completely off the books.

mag-ward-7.summary: Tier-4 Mage Wardcraft passive (max rank 3) requiring Unravel Hex, granting broad resistance against all elemental damage.
mag-ward-7.flavor: Rather than blocking fire, frost, or lightning head-on, a refracting ward bends the worst of the impact sideways into the dirt. It scorches the grass around the caster's boots, yet leaves their coat unblemished.

mag-ward-8.summary: Tier-4 Mage Wardcraft capstone (max rank 2) requiring Conservation Law, locking a target in temporary astral stasis.
mag-ward-8.flavor: Borrowed from First-Dynasty vault seals designed to keep dangerous relics from decaying. Trapped inside a pale blue glyph, even a charging colossus hangs motionless in mid-stride while the company regroups around it.

nec-bone-1.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Bonecraft passive (max rank 5) that increases the maximum health of raised minions.
nec-bone-1.flavor: Freshly raised parish dead are brittle things that snap like dry kindling under a mace. Packing their hollow shins with tallow and lime-dust keeps a skeleton standing through twice as many blows before it needs re-knitting.

nec-bone-2.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Bonecraft passive (max rank 5) that increases damage dealt by bone spells.
nec-bone-2.flavor: Probate clerks keep a steel awl on their desk for punching vellum tallies; field necromancers file the tip needle-sharp for grim work. Driven by grave-mana, sharpened bone splinters punch cleanly through boiled leather.

nec-bone-3.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Bonecraft active skill (max rank 4) requiring Reinforced Marrow, restoring health to damaged minions.
nec-bone-3.flavor: Why dig up a fresh corpse in the rain when the one you already bound just needs its ribs wired back together? A quick flick of the wand snaps cracked femurs straight and keeps the frontline marching.

nec-bone-4.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Bonecraft passive (max rank 2) requiring Sharp Awl, increasing the maximum number of active minions.
nec-bone-4.flavor: Any lazy clerk can track one debtor; a proper Border bookkeeper runs two columns at once without smudging the ink. Balancing extra bindings strains the temples, yet an extra pair of bony hands always earns its keep.

nec-bone-5.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Bonecraft passive (max rank 4) requiring Marrow Mend, causing bone attacks to inflict bleeding.
nec-bone-5.flavor: Clean steel cuts neatly and bandages easily; jagged bone fragments break off inside the wound and keep working with every step. Mercenaries on the receiving end rarely complain for long.

nec-bone-6.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Bonecraft active skill (max rank 3) requiring Double Entry, erupting jagged bone spikes beneath foes.
nec-bone-6.flavor: The northern roads are paved over three centuries of forgotten skirmishes and pauper ditches. Calling up what lies two feet under the mud turns a quiet trail into a forest of pale, razor-sharp stakes.

nec-bone-7.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Bonecraft passive (max rank 3) requiring Splintering Rib, substantially boosting minion attack damage.
nec-bone-7.flavor: Bolting scrap iron bands around skeletal forearms adds weight that living muscles would tire of carrying in ten minutes. Dead servants never complain about sore wrists, and their blows hit like quarry hammers.

nec-bone-8.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Bonecraft capstone (max rank 2) requiring Bone Spike Eruption, raising a massive high-health bone golem.
nec-bone-8.flavor: When a whole parish defaults on its tithes, the probate office consolidates the debt into a single hulking frame of wired ribs and ironstone. Slow, silent, and terrifyingly durable, it absorbs punishment meant for an entire squad.

nec-prob-1.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Probate passive (max rank 5) that increases damage-over-time from curses and afflictions.
nec-prob-1.flavor: On the Border, an unpaid debt never sits still—it compounds quietly while you sleep until it swallows your farm. Probate hexes work the exact same way, gnawing deeper into a foe's vitals with every passing second.

nec-prob-2.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Probate passive (max rank 5) that grants steady regeneration while curses are active.
nec-prob-2.flavor: Every proper ledger demands that whatever leaves one column must appear in another. As a cursed enemy withers in the mud, a thin trickle of stolen vigor settles neatly onto the necromancer's own side of the page.

nec-prob-3.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Probate active skill (max rank 4) requiring Accrued Interest, cursing enemies to weaken their attacks.
nec-prob-3.flavor: Stamped with a phantom wax seal that feels like a millstone hung around the shoulders. Even a charging basalt brute swings sluggishly once a probate clerk reads the terms of his forfeiture aloud.

nec-prob-4.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Probate passive (max rank 4) requiring Balanced Scales, restoring health when cursed enemies die.
nec-prob-4.flavor: Closing an account brings a quiet, practical satisfaction to any border bailiff. When a marked foe finally drops, the snapped lien floods back into the caster, knitting scratches and steadying tired legs.

nec-prob-5.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Probate passive (max rank 3) requiring Writ of Weakness, lowering resistances on cursed targets.
nec-prob-5.flavor: A thorough auditor finds every hidden crack in a merchant's strongbox and every gap in a knight's plate. Under this scrutiny, elemental wards and thick hides alike peel back like damp paper.

nec-prob-6.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Probate active skill (max rank 3) requiring Blood Receipt, transferring health between units.
nec-prob-6.flavor: Vitality is just another commodity on the frontier, and smart officers move it where the line is thinnest. Siphoning strength across the ledger keeps a failing frontliner upright long enough to seal the breach.

nec-prob-7.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Probate passive (max rank 2) requiring Audit the Living, spreading active curses to additional foes.
nec-prob-7.flavor: Third-Dynasty law held that when a debtor fell, his nearest kin inherited the balance on the spot. In battle, that same cruel clause leaps straight from a dying raider onto the comrade standing beside him.

nec-prob-8.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Probate capstone (max rank 2) requiring Transfer Balance, detonating all active curses for burst damage.
nec-prob-8.flavor: No extensions, no grace periods, and no appeals—just every outstanding hex called in simultaneously with a deafening crack. Whole packs of weakened foes fold at once when the clerk slams the book shut.

nec-abbey-1.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Abbey passive (max rank 5) that grants cold and poison resistance.
nec-abbey-1.flavor: Coastal abbey sextons pack their shrouds in coarse sea-salt and dried rue to keep crypt-damp and marsh-fever out of their lungs. It stings the eyes at first, yet it lets a watcher work through winter fog unharmed.

nec-abbey-2.summary: Tier-1 Necromancer Abbey passive (max rank 5) that increases mind resistance against mental and astral effects.
nec-abbey-2.flavor: Sitting vigil beside drowned sailors teaches a monk to ignore whispers in the dark. After a few years of listening to tide-bells and restless spirits, ordinary battlefield terror barely raises the pulse.

nec-abbey-3.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Abbey active skill (max rank 4) requiring Salt Preservative, releasing censer fumes that slow enemies.
nec-abbey-3.flavor: Swinging a heavy bronze pot packed with damp peat-resin and bitter herbs rolls a thick gray fog across the flagstones. Charging raiders cough, stumble, and lose their momentum inside the acrid cloud.

nec-abbey-4.summary: Tier-2 Necromancer Abbey passive (max rank 1) requiring Witness's Calm, sealing corpses to prevent enemy revivals.
nec-abbey-4.flavor: A quiet word, a pinch of quicklime, and a thumb pressed to the brow—simple parish work that ruins an ash-tongue shaman's whole afternoon. Once sealed by an abbey arbiter, the dead stay decently dead.

nec-abbey-5.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Abbey passive (max rank 3) requiring Censer Fumes, projecting an aura that reduces shadow damage.
nec-abbey-5.flavor: Where an oath-keeper stands, the chill of the ossuary loses its teeth. Allies fighting within earshot of his quiet liturgy find dark curses sliding off their armor like rain off greased canvas.

nec-abbey-6.summary: Tier-3 Necromancer Abbey active skill (max rank 3) requiring Last Rites, dealing heavy banishing damage to enemies.
nec-abbey-6.flavor: Delivered with the flat finality of a bell tolling the end of a watch. Undead husks and summoned horrors shudder and break apart under the formal command to vacate the premises.

nec-abbey-7.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Abbey passive (max rank 3) requiring Vow of Quiet, amplifying the caster's healing power.
nec-abbey-7.flavor: Not all abbey clerks deal only in coffins; many spent years tending frostbitten fishermen and bruised levy-men. Their steady, unhurried mendings stretch meager bandages and scarce mana twice as far.

nec-abbey-8.summary: Tier-4 Necromancer Abbey capstone (max rank 2) requiring Dismiss the Watch, forging a lasting spiritual link on the field.
nec-abbey-8.flavor: The oldest liturgy of the coastal abbeys, spoken only when the seawall is cracking and retreat is off the table. Bound together in solemn witness, the company endures blows that would scatter lesser troops.

pref-stout.summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for weapons, armor, shields, and helms that grants a small bonus to Body.
pref-stout.flavor: Border smiths leave extra iron in the haft and thicker leather in the straps when they know a recruit will abuse his kit. Nothing elegant about it—just honest weight that helps a tired soldier keep his feet.

pref-oxen.summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, armor, shields, and boots that provides a modest Body increase.
pref-oxen.flavor: Named for the broad-shouldered draft beasts that haul salt wagons through axle-deep Redmarsh mire. Gear stamped with the Oxen mark feels stubbornly solid, lending its wearer the grit to shrug off heavy shoves.

pref-quarry-born.summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for weapons, armor, and shields that grants a solid bonus to Body.
pref-quarry-born.flavor: Tempered in the smoky pit-forges of the Deep Quarry where ironstone dust coats every lung and every anvil. Armor and blades bearing this craft carry the dense, unforgiving heft of freshly split basalt.

pref-colossus-wrought.summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, armor, and shields that delivers a high Body bonus.
pref-colossus-wrought.flavor: Forged over caldera vents using salvaged fragments of awakened siege-golems. Even a lean veteran feels his grip harden and his stance widen the moment he buckles on colossus-wrought steel.

pref-lucid.summary: Tier-1 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, rings, and amulets that adds a small bonus to Mind.
pref-lucid.flavor: Wiped clean with vinegar and etched with a single neat margin-line by hedge-scholars who hated foggy thinking. It clears the headache of a wet march and keeps simple incantations crisp.

pref-scribe-marked.summary: Tier-2 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and rings that grants a modest boost to Mind.
pref-scribe-marked.flavor: Tiny probate tallies and copper-ink notes line the inner rim of these pieces. Clerks of the lower parishes swore that keeping good arithmetic close to the skin sharpened a caster's focus under pressure.

pref-vesperal.summary: Tier-3 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that provides a solid Mind increase.
pref-vesperal.flavor: Enchanted during the quiet hour between dusk and the first watch-bell, when coastal abbey scriptoriums fall completely silent. Wearers find their thoughts cutting cleanly through smoke, noise, and panic.

pref-archon-forged.summary: Tier-4 gear prefix for weapons, helms, armor, and amulets that grants a high Mind bonus.
pref-archon-forged.flavor: Crafted by senior Spire Conclave masters who measured mana-flow down to the last copper filament. Holding an archon-forged piece feels like stepping into a well-lit study in the middle of a riot.
